**A security update, plus two fixes**

- **Includes the Node.js fix for the eMudhra certificate problem.** Eight certificates from the eMudhra certificate authority had keys so weak that anyone could make a fake HTTPS certificate with them. 0.12.6 is built on Node.js 24.22.1, which stops trusting them. LatestArr relies on that when it connects to your media servers, your email server, single sign-on and poster images. The risk needs someone on the network in between, but please update.
- **Back to options.** A design switched to code can now go back to its options from the design editor. Changes made to the code are dropped, and it asks first.
- **A Media List's random fallback stops at 100 items,** like the list itself. Only designs written in code could go past it.

Also updates markdown-it, which turns intro and footer notes into email HTML, to fix two slow-parsing issues. LatestArr doesn't use the parts affected.
